claims.evidence: PRIDE instrument field; deposited ProteinPilot search sets instrument to QSTAR ESI
Deposited ProteinPilot XML: sample type iTRAQ 4plex, fixed iTRAQ4plex on K and peptide N-term; keyword iTRAQ-labeling

claims.value: iTRAQ4plex K/N-term fixed, Carbamidomethyl C fixed

claims.evidence: Inferred from QSTAR iTRAQ MS/MS identification search; not stated in protocols

limitations: PRIDE protocols are 'Not available' and the paper (JPR 2014, doi 10.1021/pr4012552, PMID 24670152) is closed access with no PMC/Unpaywall copy; no sample sheet deposited. Channel-to-sample/condition mapping (control vs beta-glucan) is undecodable; all treatment/disease/age/sex/individual are 'not available'.

Source names are run+channel placeholders (<run>_iTRAQ11x); characteristics[biological replicate]=1 is a placeholder required by the template, NOT a real replicate number. Same donor/condition across runs cannot be linked.
Run names (A/B/C + number, a/b suffixes, three dates) probably encode SCX fractions/sets/repeats but are undecodable; fraction identifier=1 for every run, no fractionation column claimed.
Only the 44 .wiff files are listed as data files; the 44 companion .wiff.scan files are part of the same WIFF acquisitions and not separate rows.

Dissociation, reduction and alkylation reagents not stated -> not available (Carbamidomethyl C fixed taken from search parameters). Variable Paragon biological-mod search set not listed. Acquisition method DDA is inferred.
Organism part for the vesicle preparation not stated -> not available. No factor values (no mapped comparison).

UNRESOLVED (independent review FAIL, sandbox only): the file assumes all four iTRAQ channels (114-117) carry a sample in every run, but the deposited ProteinPilot XMLs flag only two channels as used per search set (110412NewDBsearch.xml and 120402WojAllIni.xml: IT115, IT117; 110412NewDBOct.xml: IT114, IT116). Runs were not mapped to these flags, so some of the 176 rows may be empty channels. Also missing: sdrf version, developmental stage; alkylation reagent is iodoacetamide per the deposited search (not recorded).
